records.tipping_assumption: The gum meaningfully organizes the retained conditioning coating rather than only modifying product texture.
records.application_context: Retained leave-on hair-fibre application; small amount on towel-dried or dry hair; style as usual. No scalp or shampoo-removal assessment.

records.product_key: L’Oréal Professionnel|Metal Detox Beschermende geconcentreerde olie|NL|50ml
records.reason: The dimethicone/dimethiconol conditioning system supports a cohesive retained film within aqueous/solvent delivery. PEG-14 dimethicone and polyquaternium-7 supply complementary conditioning clues, not independently proven adhesive/gum mechanisms. Polyacrylamide remains rheology, and PEG-60 hydrogenated castor oil remains a solubilizer/emulsifier.
records.tipping_assumption: The silicone gum route remains functionally substantive after application; the high reading does not require actual plasticization, particular deposition, or a persistent-film role for every polymer.
records.application_context: Retained leave-on hair-fibre application; 1–2 pumps warmed in palms, applied from mid-lengths to ends on dry or towel-dried hair; do not rinse, then blow-dry or air-dry. No scalp or shampoo-removal assessment.

records.product_key: L’Occitane en Provence|Huile Cheveux Réparation Intense|FR|50ml
records.reason: The complete ester/alkane and fixed-oil system favors an ordinary retained fluid coat. Hydrogenated coco-glycerides supply a real film-forming/structuring counter-signal, but generic capability does not establish a particularly cohesive whole-film architecture. No late-rank trace assumption, supplier melting grade or percentage is imported.
records.tipping_assumption: The modified glycerides contribute meaningfully within a fluid emollient coating rather than becoming the organizing mechanism of a particularly cohesive film.
